Question Choices: Select. Do the side lengths 5, 12, and 13 form a right triangle? ~~Yes | No~~
Solution: Use the longest side 13 as the possible hypotenuse. 5²+12²=169, while 13²=169. The values are equal, so the converse of the Pythagorean theorem proves a right triangle.
